items.text: The real Cloudflare Pages router must accept the packaged APK Origin null preflight for activation health events and shop runtime
items.acceptance: compiled Pages worker returns exact CORS headers for approved paths and rejects unapproved origins

items.text: APK connection test must call a real JSON mobile-health endpoint and detect stale SPA fallback instead of reporting a false network error
items.acceptance: health returns stable JSON; APK validates it and falls back to the legacy authenticated API reachability probe when production is still old

items.text: V Easy v1.0.11 must not require the custom x-veasy-app-version request header that v1.0.10 production CORS did not allow
items.acceptance: activation and authenticated runtime work against both the existing production CORS contract and the new web patch

items.text: Mobile events and bot readiness start stop use real server endpoints and matching request and response shapes
items.acceptance: events are account and shop scoped with no customer PII; mobile uses canonical bot endpoint and surfaces polling failures without silent catch

items.text: Boss receives only VisionD Web v0.14.112 ZIP and signed V Easy APK v1.0.11 while matching Source stays private
items.acceptance: both files pass archive signature and version checks; private Source builds the APK reproducibly

items.text: The hotfix must be installed and activated on the approved Redmi after deploying the web ZIP first
items.acceptance: Production health shows ONLINE and real activation reaches the server; subsequent product order bot and event calls do not fail CORS
